concept.title: Brake System Overview
concept.shortdesc: How the blended braking system combines electrodynamic and friction braking.

section.title: Braking modes
section.p: The unit uses a blended braking system that prioritizes the electrodynamic brake and supplements it with the pneumatic friction brake when required.

ul.li: Pneumatic friction brake — supplementary and parking.

section.title: Mode selection
section.note: Do not test the magnetic track brake on a populated platform track.
